qas.question: Under the EU AI Act, what maximum fine can the Commission impose on a general-purpose AI model provider that gives misleading answers to a Commission information request?
qas.answer: Up to 3% of the provider's annual total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year or EUR 15 000 000, whichever is higher. The information request itself must state these Article 101 fines.

evidence.quote: set a period within which the information is to be provided, and indicate the fines provided for in Article 101 for supplying incorrect, incomplete or misleading information.
fines not exceeding 3 % of their annual total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year or EUR 15 000 000, whichever is higher

qas.question: Under the EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689), what is the maximum administrative fine for an undertaking breaching the Article 50 transparency obligations?
qas.answer: Up to EUR 15 000 000 or, for an undertaking, up to 3% of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.

evidence.quote: shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 15 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 3 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher
(g) transparency obligations for providers and deployers pursuant to Article 50.

qas.question: Under the EU AI Act, where does money go when the European Data Protection Supervisor penalises an EU agency, and what must such penalties not affect?
qas.answer: The money contributes to the general budget of the Union. The fines must not affect the effective operation of the fined Union institution, body, office or agency.

evidence.quote: Funds collected by imposition of fines in this Article shall contribute to the general budget of the Union.
